components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The clearest action on a surface, using the readable dark-green action pair.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: linear-gradient(165deg, var(--bt-action, #087454), var(--bt-action-deep, #065F46) 115%); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(8,116,84,0.28); font-family: 'Nunito Sans', 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.14s ease, box-shadow 0.14s ease, opacity 0.14s ease, transform 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(31,26,23,0.10); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bt-accent, #14B885); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-primary { transition: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: none; } }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A nearby secondary action that stays quiet without disappearing.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--bt-border, #E8E2DC); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--bt-subtle, #F7F3EF); color: var(--bt-text-1, #1F1A17); font-family: 'Nunito Sans', 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.14s ease, box-shadow 0.14s ease, transform 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--bt-border, #E8E2DC); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bt-accent, #14B885); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-ghost { transition: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: none; } }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A warm surfaced field with a clear green focus halo.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 5px; color: var(--bt-text-2, #7C746E); font-family: 'Nunito Sans', 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field-input { min-height: 44px; width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--bt-border, #E8E2DC); border-radius: 14px; outline: none; background: var(--bt-surface, #FFFDFB); color: var(--bt-text-1, #1F1A17); font: 400 14px/1.5 'Nunito Sans', 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: var(--bt-text-3, #A8A09A); } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color: var(--bt-accent, #14B885); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(20,184,133,0.12); } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bt-accent, #14B885); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-field-input { transition: none; } }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: The default warm work surface for routine content and controls.
components.html:
Today’s sessions

Your recorded study sessions appear here.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--bt-border, #E8E2DC); border-radius: 20px; background: var(--bt-surface, #FFFDFB); box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(31,26,23,0.055); color: var(--bt-text-1, #1F1A17); font-family: 'Nunito Sans', 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.4; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-card-copy { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--bt-text-2, #7C746E); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Ink Progress Card
components.description: An earned dark-green moment for important progress or completion.
components.css: .ds-ink-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 20px; background: radial-gradient(120% 100% at 88% -12%, rgba(20,184,133,0.38), transparent 55%), linear-gradient(178deg, var(--bt-ink-soft, #114134), var(--bt-ink, #0B2E23) 70%); box-shadow: 0 16px 44px rgba(9,38,29,0.30); color: var(--bt-ink-text, #F2FBF7); font-family: 'Nunito Sans', 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-ink-card::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; background: radial-gradient(130% 140% at 50% 0%, transparent 45%, rgba(0,0,0,0.28) 100%); opacity: 0.5; } .ds-ink-card > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; } .ds-ink-kicker { margin: 0; color: var(--bt-ink-muted, #8FD4B8); font-size: 12px; } .ds-ink-value { display: block; margin-top: 20px; font-size: 41px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.035em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ink-track { height: 10px; margin-top: 12px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); } .ds-ink-track span { display: block; width: 62%; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #14B885, #2BD9A4); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: A quiet pill track with one clearly elevated active mode.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid var(--bt-border, #E8E2DC); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--bt-subtle, #F7F3EF); font-family: 'Nunito Sans', 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-segment { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: var(--bt-text-3, #A8A09A); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-segment.is-active { background: var(--bt-surface, #FFFDFB); color: var(--bt-text-1, #1F1A17); box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(31,26,23,0.055); } .ds-segment:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-segment:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bt-accent, #14B885); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-segment { transition: none; } .ds-segment:active { transform: none; } }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: A quiet active route with mint fill, green text, and a slim green rail.
components.html: Timer
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 16px; color: var(--bt-text-2, #7C746E); text-decoration: none; font: 500 14px/1.25 'Nunito Sans', 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background-color 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease, transform 0.12s ease; } .ds-nav-item.is-active { background: var(--bt-accent-bg, #EAFBF4); color: var(--bt-accent-dark, #0E8F68); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item.is-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 8px; bottom: 8px; width: 3px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--bt-accent, #14B885); } .ds-nav-icon, .ds-nav-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--bt-subtle, #F7F3EF); } .ds-nav-item:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bt-accent, #14B885); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav-item { transition: none; } .ds-nav-item:active { transform: none; } }

components.name: Task Checkbox
components.description: A native checkbox with a rounded green completion state and visible check.
components.css: .ds-task { display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--bt-text-1, #1F1A17); font: 500 14px/1.4 'Nunito Sans', 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-task-check { appearance: none; width: 20px; height: 20px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; flex: 0 0 auto; border: 1.5px solid var(--bt-text-4, #C4BCB6); border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-task-check::after { content: ''; width: 64%; height: 64%; background: #fff; clip-path: polygon(14% 44%, 0 59%, 42% 100%, 100% 19%, 84% 5%, 40% 65%); transform: scale(0); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-task-check:checked { border-color: var(--bt-accent, #14B885); background: var(--bt-accent, #14B885); } .ds-task-check:checked::after { transform: scale(1); } .ds-task-check:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bt-accent, #14B885); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-task-check, .ds-task-check::after { transition: none; } }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A compact semantic count or status that remains secondary to the main action.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { min-height: 28px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--bt-accent-bg, #EAFBF4); color: var(--bt-accent-dark, #0E8F68); font: 700 12px/1 'Nunito Sans', 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
Blocus Tracker feels like a prepared study desk: warm, calm, and ready for work. Paper-like off-white surfaces, quiet warm-gray borders, and direct green signals keep repeated daily use comfortable, while typography and spacing favor quick scanning over decorative display.

The system earns intensity instead of spreading it everywhere. Deep green ink surfaces and authored radial light mark high-value focus, progress, and completion moments; ordinary management stays on restrained cards. Motion is brief, tactile, and state-driven, and secondary correction or management actions appear through progressive disclosure so the main task remains obvious.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, paper-like surfaces with quiet borders.
Dark green ink surfaces reserved for high-value focus and achievement moments.
Readable, mobile-first controls with at least 44px targets.
Short, tactile transform/opacity motion with reduced-motion equivalents.
Progressive disclosure keeps correction and management actions nearby but secondary.

rules.name: The Green Signal Rule
rules.body: Use bright Study Green to communicate progress or a meaningful active state; use the darker Action Green pair for readable controls.

rules.name: The Ink Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Reserve Brand Ink for high-value focus, progress, and completion moments, never for routine content cards.

rules.name: The One Interface Voice Rule
rules.body: Nunito Sans is the default; Quicksand appears only when the brand itself is speaking.

rules.name: The Stable Number Rule
rules.body: Time, XP, streaks, counts, dates, and percentages use tabular numerals so changing values do not shift their layout.

rules.name: The 44-Pixel Rule
rules.body: Every primary control, field, segmented option, and icon-only action reaches at least 44px on touch layouts.

rules.name: The Quiet Lift Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces stay calm; elevation increases only for interaction or true layer changes.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Build atmosphere with authored gradients and radial light, never with generic grain overlays.

dos: Do use the warm semantic surface stack before adding elevation.
Do keep primary actions in the dark Action Green pair and progress indicators in bright Study Green.
Do reserve dark ink surfaces for focus, meaningful progress, and completion.
Do use tabular numerals for any value that updates or aligns with another value.
Do preserve keyboard focus, 44px touch targets, safe areas, dark mode, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do reveal correction, deletion, and detailed management actions progressively.
donts: Don't spread Brand Ink across ordinary management cards or use it as a generic dark panel.
Don't add generic grain, noise, or decorative texture; depth comes from tonal radial light and restrained shadow.
Don't use Quicksand as the general interface font.
Don't use bright green for dense text when the darker green role is available.
Don't let course colors carry status meaning or replace labels, icons, and semantic feedback.
Don't animate layout properties or leave motion running when reduced motion is requested.
